entries.message: 🎨 Completely redesigned UI to a cozy cabin theme with warm wood tones, amber glows, and subtle animations.
🔧 Added Spotify – the first app in the new Apps & Tools section (tool tag).
💎 Added Geometry Dash – a rhythm-based platformer with procedurally generated levels (RIP).
💎 Added Portal – a first-person puzzle-platform video game developed and published by Valve.
🚨 Added Security Booth: Director's Cut – a PSX-style horror simulation game set in a secretive 1996 science lab.
🌱 Added Plants vs Zombies Replanted – a revival of the classic tower defense strategy game (RIP).
🧩 Added OutOfCtrl – a GMTK Game Jam 2020 puzzle game inspired by Baba is You.
🤜 Added Stick It To The Stickman – a physics-brawler rogue-lite where you fight stick men to get your job back (reupload).
👻 Added That's Not My Neighbor – a doppelganger detection horror game (reupload).
🍖 Added Beso's Shawarma – a haunting PSX-style horror experience!
🪦 Added The Henry Stickmin Collection (RIP) with download warning.
🎮 Added ClassicUs – a refined classic Among Us experience with up to 100 players.
🩸 Added HUMAN EXPENDITURE PROGRAM – a Harvey Harvington virtual pet visual novel (reupload).
🩸 Added Bloodmoney – a psychological horror clicker game (reupload).
🦊 Added Foxo's Fun Schoolhouse – a creepy psychological horror experience.
💨 Added Sonic Time Twisted – a Sonic fan game modeled after Sonic CD and Sonic 3 & Knuckles.
🎮 Added game request system with 12-hour cooldown.
♻️ Added REUPLOAD and RIP badges to game cards.
📜 Added Devlog page – track all updates and changes!
🚀 Launched Melozzy Games with Take Care Of The Cat, Undertale Yellow, and Poom.
